plantReference: Late-1990s Westinghouse 4-loop PWR. REBASED 2026-09-06 from the US EPR: the EPR RCS is a Westinghouse-lineage design so the loop, SG primary side and RCP mechanicals ported almost unchanged, but the electrical input system, the MCR presentation layer and several deferred plans did not. Upside of the rebase: real UFSARs are public (Watts Bar, Vogtle, Callaway, Comanche Peak, Seabrook), so estimates can be replaced with sourced numbers instead of staying approx forever.
phase: Hardwired benchboard panels. There is no PICS layer to defer - a late-90s W MCR is all hardwired panels plus a plant computer and SPDS CRTs for indication only, so what was 'SICS-first' is now simply the whole control room. Controls are LATCHING (Rot2p/Rot3p) until a spring-return controller exists; latching breaker/pump controls use the out-of-correspondence convention in _schema.md.

systems.notes: 2026-09-06; switchyard -> MSUT -> generator bus -> UAT/RAT -> 6.9kV bus incomers, with the automatic fast/residual bus transfer scheme. Replaces the old EPR-style SWYD/NAT/NBUS chain that used to live in rcs/rcp.json. Awaiting Andriy's drawio pass.

NOT started - deliberately out of scope 2026-09-06. Will own: NBUS-{n} (migrating out of eps/offsite.json), 480V load centers and MCCs with a normally-open cross-tie, 4.16kV Class 1E buses, TWO EDGs (trains A and B), one AAC/SBO diesel. Replaces the EPR-era SBO-* cluster still sitting in rcs/rcp.json.
125VDC batteries/chargers and the 120VAC vital inverters. This is what the io_state 'powered' flag on a switch should be reading; right now it is hardcoded true.

2026-07-03, rebased 2026-09-06. Motor -> ~7000hp/5.2MW 6-pole, buses -> 6.9kV, ammeter rescaled, #1 seal leakoff unit bug fixed. Standstill seal + N2 DELETED (post-2010 backfit, no late-90s equivalent). Automatic RCP trip on SI DELETED - Westinghouse trips the pumps by hand against the E-0/ES-0.1 subcooling criteria; see RCP-TRIP-CRITERIA. Pending Andriy review.

2026-07-10, rebased 2026-09-06. Topology unchanged (already W convention, elbow taps included). Per-leg pipe sizes, ~96,000 gpm loop flow, Th/Tc ~618/~557F, W low-flow trip logic, and SI nozzles as four cold-leg accumulators + RWST/sump instead of MHSI/LHSI/IRWST.

2026-07-10, rebased 2026-09-06. PRIMARY SIDE ONLY. Model F class numbers (~6,633 tubes, ~860 MWt, 2485 psia design). Deferred secondary plan revised: FIVE code safeties per steam line plus a power-operated atmospheric relief valve - no MSRT, that was EPR.

Surge line (loop 3) and spray taps (loops 2&3) already stubbed in loop.json; owns RCS-PRESS. W arrangement: 2 PORVs with block valves + 3 code safeties, and PORV feed-and-bleed - not the EPR relief train.

Rod control. PARTLY IMPLEMENTED ALREADY in code: rod_sim.py plus the Rod Bank Selector (RotNp, ten detents) and Rod Control Lever (Rot3pSpring) on the MRCS section, plus the Fast Withdraw test switch and - borrowed from the two systems below until they land - a boric acid control and the RPS trip breakers, with a TEMPORARY reactivity/period power model standing in for the neutronics - see 'What this is not' in server/API.md. Abbreviated ROD rather than the Westinghouse 'RCS' because RCS is the Reactor Coolant System in these files. Will own: 53 RCCAs in four shutdown and four control banks, the CRDM magnetic jacks, the bank overlap and speed programs, the C-1/C-2/C-5 rod stops, and DRPI. Depends on RPS for the trip breakers (the 118% high-flux trip in rod_sim.py is a stand-in) and on a Tavg program for automatic control, which currently chases turbine load instead.

PARTLY IMPLEMENTED ALREADY in code, and badly on purpose: rod_sim.py carries a boric acid control switch and a 0-100% concentration meter, worth 80 pcm/% as a deviation from a nominal 50%, moving ~20x faster than a real charging path could. Replace with ppm at -10 pcm/ppm when this lands. RCP dependency: seal injection (~8 gpm/pump). loop.json dependency: charging and letdown. W arrangement: VCT, centrifugal charging pumps, regen/letdown HX and orifices, one normal charging path plus an alternate.
RCP dependency: thermal barrier, oil coolers. W: component cooling water + service water, two trains.

Turbine-generator. PARTLY IMPLEMENTED ALREADY in code: turbine_sim.py plus the Gen Breaker switch, synchroscope and Gen Load gauge. eps/offsite.json depends on it for generator output onto IPB, the GEN-52 sync permissive, and the turbine trip contact that initiates every fast bus transfer.

Reactor protection. PARTLY IMPLEMENTED ALREADY in code: the two trip breakers (RTA/RTB in series) and their four panel pushbuttons live in rod_sim.py, with exactly one automatic input - power range flux high at 118%. The manual trip diverges: one button per train here, where a real W manual trip is two buttons either of which de-energizes both trains. W-specific inputs to capture: low loop flow (2-of-3 channels per loop, one loop above P-8 or two above P-7), RCP bus undervoltage and underfrequency, RCP breaker position, and reactor trip on SI.
SI actuation. Trips the reactor, NOT the RCPs - see rcs/rcp.json RCP-TRIP-CRITERIA.
Four cold-leg accumulators, centrifugal charging/SI, intermediate-head SI, RHR as low-head SI, RWST then containment sump recirculation, hot-leg recirc switchover. No IRWST.

Post-TMI instrumentation, present at any late-90s plant and newly needed: subcooling margin monitor (feeds the RCP trip criteria), RVLIS (its dynamic-head correction depends on how many RCPs are running), core exit thermocouples, SPDS.

pendingDecisions: UNIT SYSTEM: every gauge and param is still metric (degC, bar, m3/h). A US benchboard reads degF, psig and gpm. Not converted yet because it touches the Unity GaugeDefinitions as well as these files - decide, then do it in one pass.
SG MODEL: Model 51 / D5 / F / replacement Delta-75-76 changes tube count, heat duty and whether there is a feedwater preheater. Currently written as Model F class.
REFERENCE PLANT: picking one (Watts Bar, Vogtle, Callaway, Comanche Peak, Seabrook) turns most remaining approx:true values into sourced UFSAR numbers.
RTD BYPASS MANIFOLD: thermowell RTDs assumed (correct for the late 90s). Early-90s fidelity would instead model the bypass loop with its scoops and isolation valves.

PER-PUMP RCP MCC: the master-52 / group-bus / MCC-ATS structure in rcp.json is a deliberate sim invention rather than plant practice, kept for per-pump casualties. Real plants feed RCP auxiliaries from shared MCCs. Revisit when eps/onsite.json lands.
